name: Photo metadata remover
description: Photos can carry hidden details such as where and when they were taken. Remove them before you share a picture.

seo.metaTitle: Photo metadata remover — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Photos can carry hidden details such as where and when they were taken. Remove them before you share a picture. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/exif-strip-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Photo metadata remover processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/exif-strip-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Photo metadata remover upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Photo metadata remover executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/exif-strip-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Photo metadata remover upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Photo metadata remover executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/exif-strip-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Photo metadata remover?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/exif_strip.json or open /tools/exif-strip?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
